Mechanism Claim: Induction Head Sequence Repeater

properties.description: Detect induction heads that copy AB...A → B patterns. Measure the induction score across all attention heads.

nodes.label: Olsson et al. 2022 — In-context Learning and Induction Heads

properties.description: Identify the circuit that computes 'The war lasted from 1942 to 19XX' where XX > 42 must be predicted.

nodes.label: Hanna et al. 2023 — How Does GPT-2 Compute Greater-Than?
Mechanism Claim: Logit Lens Layer Attribution

properties.description: Apply logit lens at every residual stream layer and measure prediction accuracy buildup across depth.

nodes.label: Nostalgebraist 2020 — Interpreting GPT: the logit lens
Mechanism Claim: SAE Feature Dictionary Recovery

properties.description: Train a Sparse Autoencoder on residual stream activations and measure reconstruction fidelity and feature monosemanticity.

nodes.label: Cunningham et al. 2023 — Sparse Autoencoders Find Highly Interpretable Features
Mechanism Claim: Copy Task Token Induction

properties.description: Measure how well the model copies a token sequence [A][B]...[A] → [B] and attribute the computation to specific heads.

nodes.label: Elhage et al. 2021 — A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits

properties.description: Identify MLP layers and attention heads responsible for simple arithmetic (single-digit addition/subtraction) via causal intervention.

Mechanism Claim: Factual Recall Knowledge Attribution

properties.description: Identify where factual associations (e.g. 'The Eiffel Tower is in...') are stored using causal mediation analysis.
